seat.thickness_and_height_basis: 题面未指定；本设计选定

geometry.geometry_state: Nominal uncoated QT450-10 complete ring and Q235B shell; separate solids before welding
geometry.density_basis: Existing repository engineering design densities; mass is nominal CAD volume times density, not measured mass

datum_scheme.A: Independent shell lower installation face z=0
datum_scheme.B: Axis established from shell inner cylindrical wall, oriented with respect to A
datum_scheme.position_requirement: Bearing bore axis within a diameter 0.05 cylindrical zone relative to A|B over the 15 mm bore length

candidate_connection_geometry.segment_length_scope: Nominal connection-arc design; no weld solid, fused area, heat history, or qualified pWPS assigned

comparison_with_existing_eight_wing.scope: Geometric material comparison only; prior eight-wing thermomechanical/fatigue results keep their original geometry identity

geometry.precoat_design_scope: Eight 24mm local curved pockets on this ring; see ring-precoat-design.json and the separate 17-solid retained-layer STEP

precoat_thermal_cycle.applies_to: 首层与第二层分别执行；圆环壳外自由支承
precoat_thermal_cycle.sensing: 窗口附近与对向环体各独立测点；最冷/最热点共同控制转序
precoat_thermal_cycle.hold_timer_start: 全部规定工件测点进入190至210℃保持窗后开始计时；超出保持窗暂停并重新评价
precoat_thermal_cycle.cold_handoff: 所有测点冷态且完成清渣/层厚与对应PT交接，不以炉温代替工件温
precoat_thermal_cycle.reservation: 每层10h是容位计划；实际测温未准入则延迟转序

weave_design.center_rule: 按实际槽内外缘及内缘0.5保护带中心定位；名义R71.73，保持75mm/min按R71.98窗口参考弧推进
weave_design.endpoint_motion: 起端和止端各0.5s完整径向扫掠一次，规定电流不变，逐窗确认端部1.5mm保护带连续覆盖
weave_design.waveform: 每周期两边各驻留0.10 s，其余时间线性往返；推进与摆动独立
weave_design.endpoint_protection: 两端各0.5 s各完成一次径向扫掠；确认端部1.5mm保护带，记录实际轨迹与积分电能
weave_design.acceptance: 初始pWPS摆动设计值，截面确认全槽底/内缘保护/端部连续覆盖后冻结，不以理论摆宽认定熔宽

first_layer.protective_arc_scope: Controlled start/end coverage before final pore machining; actual travel and supply are recorded. Extra arc time does not replace continuous fused-interface acceptance.
first_layer.corner_scope: Shortest arc controls minimum supply; longest/widest/deepest pocket controls required envelope. Combining their independent extremes is a conservative design screen, not a claim that one actual window simultaneously has both lengths.
first_layer.motion: Controlled small weaving covers the full 6mm pocket bottom and inner-land protection; arc start/end coverage is checked locally
first_layer.acceptance: First-piece and each-batch cold weighing qualifies deposited supply; inspect >=0.20mm overfill and all temporary inner/end protection on each window. Retain first-Ni protection until second welding, then remove at final flush machining. Actual material chemistry and dilution govern retained-layer properties

trajectory_control.basis: Measure each machined pocket before precoat; use its own inner/outer radius and angular end faces
trajectory_control.track_start_stop_angle: Use measured window_start_angle_rad/window_stop_angle_rad for all three tracks, rather than the fixed nominal 24/71.98 angle
trajectory_control.protection_geometry: Inner-land protection 0.5mm normal to actual inner edge; terminal protection 1.5mm normal to each measured terminal face. Protection is not enlarged.
trajectory_control.nominal_accounting_scope: 72/576mm and their mass/arc-time/net-heat quantities refer to nominal 24mm windows; actual track lengths, supply and arc times are recorded and evaluated with the same formulas for each measured window
trajectory_control.qualification: First-piece macrosections confirm inner corner, terminal coverage, full radial coverage and overlap >=0.8mm on the measured-window path; verify contour and retained layers for each window
trajectory_control.STEP_scope: The 17-solid STEP is the nominal flush-machined retained-material partition, not a simulation of the melt-pool process at every tolerance corner

second_layer.radial_coverage_check: Nominal radii describe the nominal window. Actual inner/outer tracks are 1.0mm from measured edges, center track is at measured mid-radius, and the angles follow measured terminal faces; width is max(2.8mm, measured pitch+0.8mm) and <=3.0mm
second_layer.acceptance: Actual local contour >=1.75mm above measured pocket bottom, overlap >=0.8mm, no uncovered QT in final path; supply volume is not a local minimum-thickness measurement

resource_planning.planning_basis: 10h thermal occupation per independent layer and 24h delayed PT are conservative scheduling reservations, not a solved ring cooling history
resource_planning.meaning: Two 10-position stages plus 24 delay positions support an hourly supply target. A 240s supply target requires 150+150+360 positions or equivalent parallel capacity, before inspection queues.

precoat.geometry_and_input_scope: Ring-specific nominal curved pockets, retained material partitions and supply/energy integrals. Actual fused area, cooling phase path and unloaded bore displacement are evaluated separately in the design route.

final_process.geometry: complete QT450-10 ring; R20..74.98mm, t15mm; Q235B shell R75..80mm, h200mm

resource_planning.heat_slot_boundary: environment ramp used for station reservation; actual workpiece cold-temperature record governs transfer

final_process.scope: Path-length, energy, wire and station-resource design accounting for complete ring; no transfer of eight-wing manufacturing history.
final_process.lower_cavity_gas: separate inlet and filtered recovery from sealed bottom-tool feedthroughs; near atmospheric, verify both flows; no product gas holes

fixture.scope: 实际分段截面、预紧底座和上部轴压的冷态解析核算；接触坐实、基础摇摆和热态分别确认

service_bore_net_section.routing: 水口在基板z-40/-30两层径向引至外侧；气口z-55单独出侧面，不穿反锥，也不从A托环下方拖管

assumptions: 5kN及170kN·mm同向施加于z115.2锥顶；评价包含实际孔端z100/115，不使用100mm虚拟孔轴伸长
圆柱剪切系数0.90，变截面反锥使用局部I(z)积分，不以等效矩形梁代替
RF01/RF02全底面磨削贴合，18只M30预紧均匀分级施加；最小接触压和防滑储备按载荷验证
螺栓弹性转角额外同向计入，接触压缩并未据此当作零刚度；最终机台摇摆须守剩余分配
上驱动径向浮动，5kN侧向载荷经固定反锥和下背承入基座；上桥传递退锥/压环轴力

qualification.cold_loading_acceptance: 以独立A/B基准施加±5kN和±170kN·mm组合；两孔端径向变化≤6.5μm，加载卸载复测坐实与永久变化

release.sequence: 停弧、最高温<55℃且停弧≥120s→压环卸载→双止挡外退30→上退1.5主动退锥→铜瓣径退1.10→上工具升260→A托环接管→壳体与托环升140；盘/铜/下反锥保持原位

fixture.precision_budget_relationship: 6.5μm为径向夹紧分项，已含于制造装配定位28μm直径项；不得再次加到50μm总预算

quadratic_bending_check.common_bore_sampling: 128 equally spaced angles x 11 equally spaced heights; ray intersection of actual P1/P2 FE bore faces; same sample grid at every resolution

cold_structure.scope: P2 cold service stiffness and hole-shape response under qualified effective-joint assumptions. Sharp toe/root stress is retained and is not a capacity/fatigue rating; no manufacturing residual field is transferred.

manufacturing_design.method_scope: current3D thermal enthalpy FE plus independent classical cold eigenstrain kernels; no coupled complete precoat/manufacturing plastic-state solution
manufacturing_design.thermal_model: conforming shared nodes at material interfaces; active-face exterior radiation/convection only; true unwelded fit gap

main_source_target.cap_source_role: engineering effective source estimate requiring macrosection calibration; not robot TCP/standoff

mesh.interface_method: shared conforming material-interface nodes; unconnected fit gap is open

cache_key.shell_surface: 2mm z90..125; smoothly coarsen away from open fit-gap band

mesh.qualification: geometry establishes nominal contact paths, not continuous fusion or retained residual stress

material_inputs.composition_basis: 工程名义成分；Cr/Ni/Mo为当量核算的残余元素假设，按来料化学分析替换

material_inputs.basis: k: Special Metals Nickel 200 Table3, scaled sensitivity; cp(T) and latent engineering inputs; first-layer solidus parameter, not CALPHAD or observed PMZ; CI-A1 first-layer thermal proxy, not the batch phase diagram or mechanical capacity

material_inputs.name: Ni99 second

thermal_result.precoat_residual_state: not imported or solved by thermal model; independent mechanical input required

tooling_release_policy.evaluation: first accepted cooling step meeting both gates; cooling step sizes5/15/30s

thermal_result.start_permission_scope: conservative first-pass start window15..35C; subsequent pass15..100C; interpass_100C retained separately

first_arc_time_refinement.model: 3D four-node tetrahedral thermal enthalpy FE; nominal retained layers and source births; no melt transport

mesh.interface_method: shared conforming material-interface nodes; unconnected fit gap is open

cache_key.shell_surface: 2mm z90..125; smoothly coarsen away from open fit-gap band

mesh.qualification: geometry establishes nominal contact paths, not continuous fusion or retained residual stress

fusion_enthalpy.basis: 球铁冷却曲线10.3390/cryst15070614/Table7及推荐范围；按组元差异取1100～1180设计区间；潜热250 kJ/kg工程估值，批次热分析复核

material_inputs.name: 球墨铸铁 QT450-10
material_inputs.composition_basis: 工程名义成分；Cr/Ni为当量核算的残余元素假设，按来料化学分析替换

fusion_enthalpy.basis: Q235连铸研究Table2：1748/1793 K、264 kJ/kg；10.3390/ma16093361；设计借用，不是本批次DSC

material_inputs.name: 碳素结构钢 Q235B
material_inputs.composition_basis: 工程名义成分；Cr/Ni/Mo为当量核算的残余元素假设，按来料化学分析替换

material_inputs.name: CI-A1 high-Ni first layer: engineering thermophysical proxy
material_inputs.basis: k: Special Metals Nickel 200 Table3, scaled sensitivity; cp(T) and latent engineering inputs; first-layer solidus parameter, not CALPHAD or observed PMZ; CI-A1 first-layer thermal proxy, not the batch phase diagram or mechanical capacity

material_inputs.name: Ni99 second
material_inputs.basis: k: Special Metals Nickel 200 Table3, scaled sensitivity; cp(T) and latent engineering inputs; first-layer solidus parameter, not CALPHAD or observed PMZ

fusion_enthalpy.basis: Paek等JOM2021 Fig2/10.1007/s11837-020-04487-9，Fe-Ni二元边界；55～58%Ni低碳实际配混，考虑C/Si/Mn与读图差异取1420～1460设计包络；潜热275 kJ/kg工程估值

material_inputs.name: NiFe-55型镍铁铸铁实心填充棒
material_inputs.standard: EN ISO 1071 / GB/T 10044；具体实心棒分类按供货证书
material_inputs.composition_basis: CEWELD NiFe 55 TIG供方典型成分；https://certilas.com/en/product/nife-55-tig；批次证书复核
material_inputs.property_basis: 名义物性为保守工程输入，不作为供方实測接头性能；历史结果以各运行input.json为准

declared_source.root_target_basis: physical joint root r75/z115 (0.02mm from seat edge); not robot TCP or gun standoff
declared_source.cap_height_basis: effective volumetric source estimate; requires macrosection calibration; not a robot TCP instruction
declared_source.qualification: inherited engineering source input; not measured arc shape

first_arc_time_refinement.source_domain: all occupied material volumes (QT,first-layer,second-layer,NiFe,Q235); Gaussian normalized over these volumes
first_arc_time_refinement.precoat_residual_state: not imported or solved by thermal model; independent mechanical input required
first_arc_time_refinement.scope: actual final-weld thermal design calculation on retained nominal precoat geometry; precoat stress history and continuous fused interfaces remain separate inputs
first_arc_time_refinement.cooling_boundary: air20C throughout; finite copper contact during this first-arc-only calculation

manufacturing_design.cold_space_scope: safe current coarse6/.9mm and audited retained medium4.5/.65mm;3 key100microstrain modes. Near-zero symmetry axis values and local stress are reported separately; no blanket convergence or full manufacturing qualification is claimed.

cold_support.release: all tooling removed; six negligible-reaction coordinate-gauge DOFs only

manufacturing_design.precoat_residual_state: complete residual stress/plastic field not imported; nonzero redistribution kernels are independent conditional inputs, not state inheritance
manufacturing_design.response_window: conditional-window.csv contains mathematical cold-response/diameter windows and combined per-material elastic stresses; deposited-layer yield/fusion capacity is not assigned
manufacturing_design.stale_diagnostic_outputs: diagnostic-static-interface/* are rejected for early cap-interface area and duplicate internal-face environment loss; never adopted as current engineering evidence

start_temperature_permissions.scope: conservative first-pass start window15..35C; subsequent pass15..100C; interpass_100C retained separately

manufacturing_design.melting_screen_scope: temperature coverage under the declared uncalibrated Gaussian source; not continuous interface fusion, melt-transport prediction or evidence of physical300J/mm process failure

vision.statement: 数字样本测试结果，不代表真实工业相机精度；检测返回率仅表示算法给出结果，工程门限还需同时满足误差预算。

interlocked_virtual_plan.statement: 合成控制回放：联锁实际决定虚拟请求是否产生，异常反馈锁存后停止后续起弧；无设备通信。

automation.statement: 端到端结果包含数字样本和仿真过程信号，不代表实物焊接采集。

budget_inputs.meaning: 工程预算输入，非供应商报价；采购据书面报价替换

pilot_production.excludes: 设备/工装折旧、加工/清洗机电耗、毛坯、报废、取样及疲劳评定
pilot_production.condition: 全班专线人工与共享实际工时分别核算；温控等待不删去，10h为计划时隙。

primary_baseline_verification.calculation_scope: 实际圆环冷态FE、最终热过程与固有应变条件响应；不等于完整预制热塑性历史或实物评定

historical_eight_wing.route: CI-A1 ENi-CI SMAW first layer / bare low-C Ni99 second layer / 8P-R2-t15 low-input GTAW / copper barrier
historical_eight_wing.next_action: 取得适用热源与高温本构依据，闭合首层一翼冷态；继承残余状态完成实际修整、第二层、最终孔加工、组焊、完全卸夹与同状态承载。
